pkgmetadata.longdescription: Ragel 6, installed as ragel-6, so that it can be installed next to ::gentoo's dev-util/ragel at Ragel 7. The Chromium ebuild regenerates HarfBuzz's and the emoji segmenter's state machines with Ragel 6 (HarfBuzz requires 6.10): ::gentoo's dev-util/ragel-6.10 by default, or this one on systems that keep Ragel 7.
